name: What types of showers can I choose from for a replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of showers can I choose from for a replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When replacing your shower, you have several options to consider. Common choices include pre-fabricated shower inserts made from acrylic or fiberglass, which are durable and easy to install. Another popular option is a custom-tiled shower, offering extensive design flexibility with various tile materials like ceramic, porcelain, or natural stone. You can also opt for walk-in showers for accessibility and a modern aesthetic, or shower/tub combinations if you need both. Each type offers different benefits in terms of cost, aesthetics, and maintenance.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can choose from pre-fabricated inserts (acrylic/fiberglass), custom-tiled showers (ceramic, porcelain, stone), walk-in showers, or shower/tub combinations.
